facts.fact: Law 029/2023, in force on publication on 15 June 2023, provides in Articles 5 and 6 that a birth and a death, in a health facility or outside one, is registered in the CRVS system by a designated officer.

Law 029/2023 provides that a child born, or a person who dies, in a health facility is registered immediately in the CRVS system by a designated officer and that the data pass automatically to the population registry; the same transfer applies to events outside a health facility.
